column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline — per-rule dispositions. Tab-separated: <rule id>\t<WARN|IGNORE|FAIL>\t<comment>
# THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE A FINDING IS TOLERATED, and that is deliberate. `ci.yml` sets
# `fail_action: true`, so the job goes red on anything at WARN or above — which means every
# accepted finding has to be written down here, with its rule id and a reason, where it shows up
# in a diff. The alternative the action offers by default (`fail_action: false`) is a scan that
# reports findings and exits 0: the same defect as the Sonar step that submitted an analysis and
# never read the verdict, and as the deleted stage 6.
# IGNORE means "this does not apply to this system", never "we could not be bothered". If a rule
# genuinely applies, fix it in `docker/traefik/dynamic.yml` — headers belong on the terminator —
# rather than adding a line here.
# Empty on purpose right now. The first CI run against the TLS entrypoint is what says which rules
# actually fire; filling this in beforehand would be guessing, and a pre-emptive IGNORE would
# suppress a real finding before anyone had seen it. Entries get added from an observed report,
# each one naming what was seen.
